summary: DuPont filed an 8-K reporting a September 9, 2026 Settlement Agreement with North Carolina and twelve state subdivisions resolving PFAS and AFFF claims tied to the Fayetteville Works facility. The aggregate cash payment is $455 million over 15 years, shared under the 2021 Chemours/Corteva/DuPont MOU; only $18 million relates to non-Fayetteville PFAS, with up to $14.4 million tied to AFFF. DuPont booked roughly $125 million in discontinued-operations loss in Q2 2026, net of Qnity's 44% reimbursement, and a $135 million reserve fund will be posted under the 2019 Letter Agreement.
